newsitem.title: UK: Bank of Scotland leads sector rally.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Scotland leads sector rally.

text.p: Share in most UK banks resumed their recovery as institutional investors loaded up on the shares, dealers said.
"We're seeing a bit of quarter end window dressing," said one dealer. "Bank shares are such big constituents of the FTSE 100, funds need the exposure."
By 1039 GMT, shares in the Bank of Scotland were up 8-1/2p, or 2.7 percent, to 326-1/2p. Lloyds TSB Group Plc and Royal Bank of Scotland each added 10p, to 506-1/2p and 542p respectively.
Shares in Abbey National Plc climbed 13-1/2p to 741-1/2p, while Barclays Plc rose 16-1/2p to 1047. Shares in Standard Chartered Plc firmed 4-1/2 to 857-1/2.

HSBC Holdings bucked the strength in the sector, shedding 11p to 1490, dragged down by a 1.9 percent decline in the Hong Kong stock market, dealers said. Shares in National Westminster Bank Plc also slipped, easing 5-1/2p to 691-1/2.
"The sector has been amazingly volatile in the last few weeks," said another dealer.

He noted that some brokerages were turning cautious on some banks in the sector. Most recently, UBS called most bank shares expensive, though it repeated its "hold" recommendation on Lloyds and Abbey National. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 5106
